name: Cache public website pages
expression: http.host eq "zamique.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "PURGE"} and not any(http.request.headers["rsc"][*] eq "1") and not (http.request.uri.query contains "_rsc=") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/catalog" "/about" "/contact" "/custom-orders" "/faq"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/products/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/markets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wholesale/"))
query_string_policy: Preserve all query parameters; do not strip _rsc.
scope: Public HTML eligibility only. Private inquiry/admin/API and RSC requests remain outside this rule; origin privacy headers are authoritative. PURGE matches Cloudflare's internal single-file purge evaluation; it does not enable POST caching.
